product_one_liner.value: Kojo provides materials procurement and inventory management software for trade and self-perform general contractors, connecting field, office, warehouse, accounting, and distributor teams.
product_one_liner.notes: Kojo describes its materials and inventory management platform, its trade and self-perform general contractor customers, and the teams it connects: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20251016530530/en/Kojo-Poised-to-Revolutionize-Construction-Materials-Management.

pricing_page.notes: Kojo has a public pricing page describing included functionality, unlimited users and data, and custom quotes. Published numerical prices are not required under the question's definition: https://www.usekojo.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Kojo publishes customer stories for Lawson Mechanical Contractors (https://www.usekojo.com/customer-stories/lawson-mechanical-contractors) and Cardinal Civil Contracting (https://www.usekojo.com/customer-stories/cardinal-civil-contracting). Both names appear on their respective pages. | named_customers.0: Lawson Mechanical Contractors is named in its dedicated Kojo customer story: https://www.usekojo.com/customer-stories/lawson-mechanical-contractors. | named_customers.1: The customer story explicitly describes Cardinal Civil Contracting modernizing procurement with Kojo: https://www.usekojo.com/customer-stories/cardinal-civil-contracting.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 163 employees, which falls within 101-200. Profile-associated employee counts are approximate rather than audited headcounts: https://linkedin.com/company/kojotechnologies.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Kojo's company profile explicitly lists its headquarters as San Francisco, California: https://linkedin.com/company/kojotechnologies. | hq_country: Kojo's company profile identifies its primary location as San Francisco, California, United States: https://linkedin.com/company/kojotechnologies.

founded_year.notes: Kojo's company profile explicitly lists 2018 as its founding year: https://linkedin.com/company/kojotechnologies.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog index contains marketing, product, industry and company-news content (https://www.usekojo.com/blog). One qualifying technical post was found, about React Native rebranding and technical debt (https://medium.com/kojo-engineering/rebranding-to-kojo-4ad8d8660e5d), but the engineering publication's rendered index exposed no additional posts (https://medium.com/kojo-engineering). The required two-post threshold was therefore not met.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal contains multiple documentation topics, including authentication, API limits, GraphQL, REST and SCIM (https://docs.kojo.tech/docs/). Kojo's public help center also links procurement workflow and field-training articles (https://support.usekojo.com/hc/en-us/articles/54889286601491-Weekly-Release-Notes-August-17-23-2026).

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists exactly two openings: Demand Gen Lead and Revenue Operations Support Analyst. Neither title qualifies as an AI, ML or data-science role: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Kojo.

model_provider.value: OpenAI GPT-4 and Hugging Face transformer models
model_provider.notes: Kojo explicitly states that its Intelligence Layer uses OpenAI's GPT-4 and Hugging Face transformer models: https://www.usekojo.com/blog/kojo-intelligence-layer.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Kojo's security page states that it successfully completed a SOC 2 audit, rather than describing certification as in progress: https://www.usekojo.com/security. | compliance_certs.0: The security page explicitly confirms completion of the SOC 2 audit: https://www.usekojo.com/security.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company announcement explicitly calls the investment an extension to Kojo's Series C round. The newer extension takes precedence over the original September 2022 Series C: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20251016530530/en/Kojo-Poised-to-Revolutionize-Construction-Materials-Management. | funding_date: Construction Dive's Q4 2025 funding roundup identifies the $10 million Series C extension and its October 16 announcement, supporting 2025-10: https://www.constructiondive.com/news/construction-tech-funding-Q4-2025/808986. The primary announcement URL also identifies the October 2025 release. | funding_amount_usd: Kojo's announcement states that Wesco invested $10 million in its Series C extension, equivalent to USD 10,000,000. This is the newest funding announcement identified: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20251016530530/en/Kojo-Poised-to-Revolutionize-Construction-Materials-Management.

raised_18mo.notes: The $10 million Series C extension announced in October 2025 falls inside the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026. Sources: https://www.constructiondive.com/news/construction-tech-funding-Q4-2025/808986 and https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20251016530530/en/Kojo-Poised-to-Revolutionize-Construction-Materials-Management.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists only Demand Gen Lead and Revenue Operations Support Analyst, neither of which is an SDR, BDR or account executive position: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Kojo.

launched_6mo.notes: The August 2026 release introduced role-based tool-inventory permissions and the ability to operate Major POs without releases. These change access controls and procurement workflow, rather than merely fixing bugs or adjusting appearance, and fall within the six-month window. Classifying these functional releases as sufficiently substantial involves judgment: https://support.usekojo.com/hc/en-us/articles/54206867976979-Weekly-Release-Notes-Aug-1-7-2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Micah Rodman's profile dates his Co-Founder & CEO role to January 2026 (https://linkedin.com/in/micah-rodman-589776160). Maria Davidson's profile dates her Executive Chairman role to January 2026 (https://linkedin.com/in/maria-davidson-801a1058), and her website confirms she moved from CEO to Executive Chair (https://maria-davidson.com/). This establishes a CEO transition within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Kojo's Revenue Operations Support Analyst posting explicitly says its Sales and Customer Success teams run on Salesforce: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Kojo/96c079f3-712b-4782-a20f-4118d53988c7. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job posting explicitly identifies Salesforce as the system used by Kojo's Sales and Customer Success teams: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Kojo/96c079f3-712b-4782-a20f-4118d53988c7.
